reviews.review:
BOILED DOWN REVIEW: I don't know if anyone ever reads these XD but here are some key points regarding the game that I loved so much I flew half way across the world to go to Tennocon 2025 and a cute little bit at the end. 

Positives of the game:
-The grind... ok so I have heard people say "Oh Warframe is too much of a grind I don't have time for it" You don't need to get everything in the game right away, you play at your own pace, the "Grind" is really not that bad, you do a mission and get rewards, the missions are like 5 mins tops. 
-The Flow... Smooth, fast paced, when you get into it, there is no going back
-The Beautiful Graphics From the get go and can run on potato PC's, I know because I used to run it on a Potato.
-The Stunning Visuals the maps are well made and beautiful, you can explore and find small secrets.
-The Maps always feel familiar but are different each run
-Everything can be customised like everything... to the charm on your gun...
-Plenty of Enemies, many factions to slash and dash through.
-Look at all the Worlds to explore, okay a solar system and then some..
-The game has a Gripping story. Genuinely I love this story! 
-A roller coaster of emotions (if you become invested like I did)
-Beautiful audio/ music 
-The creators of the game give back to the community throughout the year, every year and this is not something many companies do
-Great community and friendly player base for the streamers out there Title your streams "Baby Tenno" thank me later.
-Hours of content. You will not find yourself short on content in this game for a long time. 
-So many Weapons, characters, pets you will have hours of collecting for everything.
-Countless ways to build your Warframe's to do all kinds of crazy things
-The game is a unique power trip that makes you a boss in game.

Negatives of the game:
-Building your stuff, this takes time and is something that you can look forward to... you'll know what I mean when you build your first frame.
-Some of the Missions can be repetitive for example Exterminate, Capture etc especially when you are trying to get things to drop (I would suggest mixing it up by going to different worlds or take a break when you need)
-Occasional Bugs (this can be funny but at times can of course be annoying)
-The main parts of the story are solo (I would prefer if Co-Op was possible)
-The "Tutorial" is Lacking to say the least.
-Early content is 13 years old and where DE are working to make it a bit more palatable, it can be tough. 
--------Reach out to the community if you want help with missions or to chunk through it fast!-----------
-The newer content despite being aimed to attract new players will confuse the F out of you (DUVIRI) - specifically this mission will be confusing as you can do it early on... 
-People in the game generally stay for only a few missions and leave forever 
-Your friends will likely not give the game enough of a chance if you get into it. (mine didn't :C )
-I am sure I will think of more just cant at this time.
- FOR STREAMERS, there is a lack of people who view this game as it is a niche but you should not let this discourage you the people are great and the game deserves more. 

So 2.5K hours on and I can keep my review mostly the same... I love this game, has a great community, though it is hard to collaborate with people long term, I hear people say all the time "Oh this game is too grindy" bro you play The First Decendant. Sure it takes time to get powerful things but such is the way of free to play. The premium currency is relatively easy to earn you just need to put time into getting what people want/ Cba to get and you can make a mint. There are so many ways to make plat

Still never seen a hacker to this day.

The Story is Fantastic and the Visuals are stunning, better then pretty much all of the triple A games being thrown up nowadays. I mostly play this by myself and with random people but its great to play with friends as well. 

For new people (And I wish I knew this when I was getting into the game) is that it takes time to get to the content that is good, like you need to grind which can be done passively but it takes time. The game does throw you in so you will likely need to ask for help from people and there is tons of ways you can do this. But overall is worth it! For anyone wondering, you need to get to Pluto for the game to get okay. but if you like being an OP Beast this is the game for you! The game is only massively challenging with Steel path until you get used to a different way of building your characters. 

The Game does receive fairly regular updates so the Post is Subject to change.
I have been with this game for over 3 years now where id say I play frequently and the updates can be some what disappointing when you have been waiting for the content for ages - Duviri... BUT the updates add a nice addition to the story as a whole, and they are getting better slowly for new people.

When people say the community is great it is alongside the devs. DE do so much for the community from weekly streams to giveaways to contests to tennocon to a ton of holidays being celebrated in game.. they are good. People are always looking to help out I do it in streams occasionally on my GousBustah channel on twitch but there are tons of people who will be willing to help if you ask. Of course you will see people who don't want anything to do with it but it is easy enough to get help. 

If you would like to play from this review please PM me and I can send a refer link.

They reworked Ember to a much more active frame. I no longer have access to my favorite frame, so playing Warframe is just a constant reminder I can't play a frame I found super fun (knock down everyone in a 100+ meter radius) for a frame that requires a lot more inputs. I've been told "oh they introduced a new frame like Ember" but Ember was the one I tweaked the colors for, she's a design I absolutely love, like... she was my main. And now she isn't.
Very much grind, lost gf bcs of the grind
